mapper.sql: SELECT B.PT_NO, B.MEMBER_PT_NO, B.TR_SNO, B.TR_SEQ, CM.CONT_NO, CM.CONT_NM, B.BAL_PT , B.USE_PT /* 원거래에서 사용된 포인트 */ , B.NET_TOTAL_USE_PT /* PT_NO 에 해당하는 순수 사용포인트의 합계(다수 거래 발생시 모두 합계) */ , B.SUM_USE_PT /* 순수 사용포인트 합계의 누적 */ FROM (SELECT PT_NO , MEMBER_PT_NO , CONT_NO , TR_SNO , TR_SEQ , BAL_PT , USE_PT , NET_TOTAL_USE_PT , SUM(NET_TOTAL_USE_PT) OVER (ORDER BY TR_SNO DESC, TR_SEQ DESC) AS SUM_USE_PT FROM (SELECT PM.PT_NO, PM.MEMBER_PT_NO, PM.CONT_NO, THD.TR_SNO, THD.TR_SEQ, PM.BAL_PT, THD.TR_PT AS USE_PT, (PM.USE_PT - PM.USE_CANCEL_PT) AS NET_TOTAL_USE_PT FROM T_PT_MST PM INNER JOIN T_CONT_MST CM ON CM.CONT_NO = PM.CONT_NO AND CM.CONT_STS_CD = 'NORMAL' AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) BETWEEN CM.START_DT AND CM.END_DT) AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) BETWEEN CM.USE_START_DT AND CM.USE_END_DT) INNER JOIN T_TR_HIST_DETAIL THD ON THD.TR_SNO = #{trSno} AND PM.PT_NO = THD.PT_NO WHERE (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) BETWEEN PM.USE_START_DT AND PM.USE_END_DT) /* 포인트 사용기간 이내이어야 사용취소 가능함 */ ORDER BY TR_SEQ DESC) A ORDER BY TR_SNO DESC, TR_SEQ DESC) AS B INNER JOIN T_CONT_MST CM ON CM.CONT_NO = B.CONT_NO ORDER BY TR_SNO DESC, TR_SEQ DESC
mapper.select: /* 포인트마스터의 유효 잔여 포인트 합계 */ SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pm.BAL_PT), 0) FROM T_PT_MST pm INNER JOIN T_CONT_MST cm ON cm.CONT_NO = pm.CONT_NO AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) BETWEEN cm.START_DT AND cm.END_DT AND cm.CONT_STS_CD = 'NORMAL' WHERE pm.CONT_NO = #{contNo} AND pm.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND pm.USE_END_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND pm.EXP_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND pm.BAL_PT > 0

/* 사용취소요청 처리 대상 조회 */ WITH TARGET_TABLE ( PT_NO, MEMBER_PT_NO, TR_SNO, TR_SEQ, CONT_NO, CONT_NM, BAL_PT, USE_PT, NET_TOTAL_USE_PT, SUM_USE_PT ) AS (
) ( SELECT TR_SNO AS ORGL_TR_SNO, @num:=@num+1 AS TR_SEQ, PT_NO, MEMBER_PT_NO, CONT_NO, CONT_NM, BAL_PT, USE_PT , USE_CANCEL_PT FROM (SELECT @num:=0) AS n, ( SELECT PT_NO, MEMBER_PT_NO, TR_SNO, TR_SEQ, CONT_NO, CONT_NM, BAL_PT, USE_PT, SUM_USE_PT ,(CASE WHEN GB = 0 THEN USE_PT - (USE_PT - NET_TOTAL_USE_PT) WHEN GB = 1 THEN #{reqPt} - SUM(USE_CANCEL_PT) OVER(ORDER BY TR_SNO DESC, TR_SEQ DESC) + USE_CANCEL_PT END) AS USE_CANCEL_PT FROM ( (SELECT 0 AS GB, PT_NO, MEMBER_PT_NO, TR_SNO, TR_SEQ, CONT_NO, CONT_NM, BAL_PT, USE_PT, NET_TOTAL_USE_PT, SUM_USE_PT , USE_PT AS USE_CANCEL_PT FROM TARGET_TABLE TT1 WHERE SUM_USE_PT < #{reqPt}) UNION ALL (SELECT 1 AS GB, PT_NO, MEMBER_PT_NO, TR_SNO, TR_SEQ, CONT_NO, CONT_NM, BAL_PT, USE_PT, NET_TOTAL_USE_PT, SUM_USE_PT , 9840 - USE_PT AS USE_CANCEL_PT FROM TARGET_TABLE TT2 WHERE SUM_USE_PT >= #{reqPt} LIMIT 1) ) AS A ORDER BY TR_SNO DESC, TR_SEQ DESC ) AS B )

WITH TARGET_TABLE ( PT_NO ,MEMBER_PT_NO ,CONT_NO ,CONT_NM ,USE_END_DT ,BAL_PT ,ACC_BAL_PT ) AS ( SELECT pm.PT_NO ,pm.MEMBER_PT_NO ,pm.CONT_NO ,cm.CONT_NM ,pm.USE_END_DT ,SUM(pm.BAL_PT) AS BAL_PT ,SUM(SUM(pm.BAL_PT)) OVER(ORDER BY pm.PT_NO DESC, pm.USE_END_DT ASC) AS ACC_BAL_PT FROM T_PT_MST pm INNER JOIN T_CONT_MST cm ON cm.CONT_NO = pm.CONT_NO AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) BETWEEN cm.START_DT AND cm.END_DT AND cm.CONT_STS_CD = 'NORMAL' WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND BAL_PT > 0 AND pm.USE_END_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND pm.EXP_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
AND pm.CONT_NO IN
#{contNo}
GROUP BY pm.PT_NO, pm.MEMBER_PT_NO, pm.CONT_NO, cm.CONT_NM, pm.USE_END_DT ORDER BY pm.PT_NO DESC, pm.USE_END_DT ASC ) ( SELECT PT_NO ,MEMBER_PT_NO ,CONT_NO ,CONT_NM ,USE_END_DT ,BAL_PT ,REQ_PT ,ACC_BAL_PT FROM ( ( ( SELECT PT_NO ,MEMBER_PT_NO ,CONT_NO ,CONT_NM ,USE_END_DT ,BAL_PT ,BAL_PT AS REQ_PT ,ACC_BAL_PT FROM TARGET_TABLE WHERE ACC_BAL_PT < #{reqPt} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT PT_NO ,MEMBER_PT_NO ,CONT_NO ,CONT_NM ,USE_END_DT ,BAL_PT ,(BAL_PT - (ACC_BAL_PT - #{reqPt})) AS REQ_PT ,(ACC_BAL_PT - (ACC_BAL_PT - #{reqPt})) AS ACC_BAL_PT FROM TARGET_TABLE WHERE ACC_BAL_PT >= #{reqPt} LIMIT 1 ) ) ) A ORDER BY PT_NO DESC, USE_END_DT ASC )
